components.name: Primary Action Button
components.description: 当前流程唯一的主要行动。
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid rgba(147, 197, 253, 0.20); border-radius: 16px; background: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.85); color: #fff; font: 500 14px/1.5 "Manrope Variable", "Noto Sans SC Variable", system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.20); transition: background-color 200ms, transform 200ms, box-shadow 200ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #60a5fa; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(147, 197, 253, 0.40); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Secondary Glass Button
components.description: 取消、辅助入口和低优先级行动。
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.10); border-radius: 16px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04); color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85); font: 500 14px/1.5 "Manrope Variable", "Noto Sans SC Variable", system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 200ms, color 200ms; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.09); color: #fff; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.20); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Glass Search Field
components.description: 顶部搜索与网址直达的组合输入。
components.html: <label class="ds-search"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8"></circle><path d="m21 21-4.35-4.35"></path></svg><input placeholder="搜索或输入网址" /></label>
components.css: .ds-search { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; width: 420px; max-width: 100%; height: 44px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14); border-radius: 16px; background: rgba(46, 48, 52, 0.76); color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65); backdrop-filter: blur(24px) brightness(85%) saturate(120%); } .ds-search svg { width: 18px; fill: none; stroke: #bfdbfe; stroke-width: 2; } .ds-search input { min-width: 0; flex: 1; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; color: #fff; font: 500 15px/1.5 "Manrope Variable", "Noto Sans SC Variable", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-search input::placeholder { color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.45); } .ds-search:focus-within { border-color: rgba(147, 197, 253, 0.60); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(147, 197, 253, 0.20); }

components.name: Category Navigation Item
components.description: 侧栏与移动顶部栏共享的分类入口。
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; min-width: 44px; height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 16px; background: rgba(147, 197, 253, 0.10); color: #dbeafe; font: 600 12px/1.333 "Manrope Variable", "Noto Sans SC Variable", system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 200ms, color 200ms, transform 200ms; } .ds-nav-icon { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 8px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.055); } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.10); color: #fff; transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(191, 219, 254, 0.70); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Link Card
components.description: 分类网格中的网址快捷入口。
components.css: .ds-link-card { display: flex; height: 96px; width: 160px; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14); border-top-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22); border-radius: 12px; background: rgba(58, 60, 64, 0.58); color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.90); backdrop-filter: blur(24px) brightness(85%) saturate(120%); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 200ms, background-color 200ms, border-color 200ms, box-shadow 200ms; } .ds-link-icon { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 28px; height: 28px; margin-bottom: 4px; border-radius: 8px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08); color: #dbeafe; font-weight: 700; } .ds-link-title { max-width: 100%; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; font: 500 14px/20px "Manrope Variable", "Noto Sans SC Variable", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-link-meta { color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.50); font: 400 12px/16px "Manrope Variable", "Noto Sans SC Variable", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-link-card:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.20); background: rgba(68, 70, 74, 0.62); box-shadow: 0 10px 18px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.20); } .ds-link-card:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(191, 219, 254, 0.75); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Floating Dock
components.description: 固定网址与拖放操作的底部功能岛。
components.css: .ds-dock { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; height: 56px; padding: 6px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14); border-top-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22); border-radius: 16px; background: rgba(46, 48, 52, 0.76); color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 14px 36px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.28); backdrop-filter: blur(24px) brightness(85%) saturate(120%); } .ds-dock button { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; background: transparent; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.72); font: 600 14px/1 "Manrope Variable", system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 200ms, color 200ms, transform 200ms; } .ds-dock button:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.10); color: #fff; } .ds-dock button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(191, 219, 254, 0.75); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-dock-divider { width: 1px; height: 28px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.10); }

narrative.overview:
LocalTab 像一张悬浮在个人壁纸前的书签工作台：界面不遮蔽用户选择的背景，而是用深色半透明表面稳定文字和操作。视觉重心始终落在用户的分类、网址和搜索任务上，品牌通过克制的雾蓝提示、精确的间距和安静的层次表达。

系统气质是克制、通透、安静、高效。密度偏紧凑，但交互目标保持宽松；装饰只服务于结构、状态和可读性，不使用高饱和多彩、厚重不透明、营销式装饰或夸张动效。
keyCharacteristics: 深色壁纸画布上的分层玻璃表面
雾蓝承担选择、聚焦和主要行动
紧凑的信息密度与清晰的 44px 高频操作目标
柔和环境阴影、细边框与短促状态反馈
中文与英文共享同一套排版节奏

rules.name: The Atmosphere-First Rule
rules.body: 背景图是体验的一部分；玻璃表面必须改善可读性，但不能把页面变成不透明深色仪表盘。

rules.name: The Quiet Accent Rule
rules.body: 雾蓝只标示行动、选择和聚焦；普通容器与大面积背景保持中性。

rules.name: The One-Family Rule
rules.body: 不为装饰引入额外字体；层级变化优先使用既有字号、字重、透明度和间距。

rules.name: The Layered Glass Rule
rules.body: 卡片、悬浮工具和覆盖层使用不同不透明度；不要用同一块玻璃值覆盖全部层级。

dos: **Do** 使用卡片、悬浮工具、覆盖层三级玻璃透明度表达层级。
**Do** 为高频图标按钮和 Dock 项目保留 44px 操作目标。
**Do** 用雾蓝表达主要行动、当前选择、聚焦和有效拖放状态。
**Do** 让中文和英文共用 Manrope 与 Noto Sans SC 的回退关系和信息层级。
donts: **Don't** 用高饱和多彩色块争夺壁纸和内容的注意力。
**Don't** 把玻璃层替换为覆盖大部分壁纸的厚重不透明面板。
**Don't** 添加营销式装饰、无功能意义的光效或夸张动效。
**Don't** 在普通内容上滥用雾蓝、危险红或高强度阴影。
**Don't** 为相同层级随意引入新的圆角、阴影或玻璃透明度。
